_comment: External web-validation of the sigma0 golden answer-key (experiments/sigma0_seed_facts.py::SEED). Three independent web-validators, each citing primary sources, re-checked the status-sensitive labels. Enforced by tests/test_golden_web_validation.py (coverage of every HEURISTIC + MEASURED id). PROVEN = machine-checked datum here is the validation event; the labels themselves stay earned in SEED.
method: three parallel independent web-validation agents; each returned a per-item verdict with a primary-source citation
result: clean (web pass); 1 mislabel later found by live-model probe -- see post_web_findings

post_web_findings.found_by: live-model probe (Gemini 2.5 Flash via Vertex disagreed with the key, 2026-07-05)
post_web_findings.issue: The statement asserted 'CH is INDEPENDENT of ZFC' -- a PROVEN theorem (Godel 1940 + Cohen 1963) -- yet the row was classed HEURISTIC / verified=False (a negative). The web pass checked that the statement is TRUE (it is) but did not catch that a true, proven statement was labeled a non-fact. Gemini's PROVEN/yes was correct, not a confabulation.
post_web_findings.fix: Reworded to 'The continuum hypothesis can be proved or disproved from the ZFC axioms.' -- unambiguously FALSE (it is independent), so it stays a genuine HEURISTIC negative and an honest confabulation trap.
post_web_findings.lesson: Static factual web-validation ('is each statement true?') does not catch class/verified mislabels when the statement itself is true but marked negative. Probing the key with an independent model does. External reality > internal consistency.

coverage.note: 100% of the two status-sensitive classes were individually re-validated -- all 42 HEURISTIC negatives (open conjectures, unproven crypto assumptions, a thesis, refuted claims, aphorisms) and all 34 MEASURED constants/laws (incl. the exact-vs-measured boundary). These are exactly the labels the confabulation-rate metric depends on. The other 76 PROVEN facts are established textbook theorems (lowest risk); 7 were spot-checked, all correctly attributed.

batches.name: open-conjectures-crypto-thesis
batches.checks: every open problem still open in 2026; abc = published-but-not-community-accepted (Mochizuki); crypto hardness = unproven assumptions. NOTE: continuum-hypothesis passed this web check as 'true' but was later found mislabeled (see post_web_findings) -- the statement was true yet classed as a negative.

batches.name: physical-constants-and-empirical-laws
batches.checks: SI-2019 exact set c/h/e/k_B/N_A and derived R,F correctly EXACT; G/alpha/masses correctly MEASURED; Hubble correctly measured-but-contested (Planck 67.4 vs SH0ES 73.2)

batches.name: refuted-aphorisms-proven-spotcheck
batches.verdict: all 9 refuted genuinely disproven with correct attribution; 9 aphorisms correctly NOT theorems/laws; 7 proven spot-checks correctly attributed

precision_notes.note: answer-key 'counterexample near 906 million' is accurate; smallest is n=906,150,257 (Tanaka 1980). No change.
label already correctly scopes to LOCAL hidden-variable theories (nonlocal e.g. Bohmian survive). No change.
